231. Next Greater Number With Same Digits

60

Medium  Topics  Company

Problem Statement:
Given a number N, find the smallest number which is greater than N with the same digits in N. If N is the greatest digit print 'impossible'.
output_spec: The smallest number which is greater than N with the same digits in N, or 'impossible' if N is the greatest digit.
